Hello!

I'm a creative producer, integrated producer, senior producer, senior project manager – whatever you want to call it.

I've spent my career turning creative briefs into real things: campaigns, content and experiences with brands like Apple, Hertz and Coinbase.

I'm at my best when I'm solving problems, working with a collaborative team, shipping great work and having fun.

Outside of work work, I run a small embroidery business, troubleshoot hundreds of feet of drip line for my California native garden and try to be a good mom to a couple of humans. I believe all of these extracurriculars make me an even better producer.

Selected Work

Coinbase - Interview Series

BaseLayer, Season 2

My Role: Senior Producer
Concept: Base Creative Office  ·  Director: Maya Margolina
Production: Registered Work  ·  Editor: Wildchild Content

BaseLayer is a mini-docuseries showcasing builders around the world. It balances the personal and the professional, telling the stories of founders in 3 to 5 minute episodes.

I produced Season 2, five episodes filmed in New York City, handling all the logistics of bringing together founders from as far as Australia and managing an ambitious one-day shoot schedule. It ruled.

Apple - Campaign

Launch of Puzzles on Apple News

My Role: Integrated Producer
Concept: Apple Marcom LA  ·  Production: Monks

Apple - Campaign

App Store Awards 2022

My Role: Integrated Producer
Concept: Apple Marcom LA
Agency (hero film): Buck  ·  Agency (winner videos): Squad 47

The App Store Awards are the biggest brand moment annually for the App Store. Every fall, with much fanfare, Apple releases its list of the best apps and games of the year.

In 2021 and 2022, I produced parts of these massive campaigns — including working with Squad 47 on individual winner films for each category winner, motion assets for each developer to post on their own socials, and supporting the production of the hero film with Buck Australia.

Coinbase - Launch Film

Base App Launch

My Role: Senior Producer
Concept: Base Creative Office  ·  Agency: Art and Graft

The Base app launched to the public in December 2025, announced at the Coinbase Product Showcase on December 17, 2025 as part of a live-streamed keynote address.

In my first project with Coinbase, I produced this film in a quick, five-week sprint with agency partner Art & Graft and our internal Base Creative Office team. We used every second of the five weeks, polishing edits hours before the livestream. Some audience members (allegedly) said it was the best part of the keynote.

"Make it on Base"
Apple - Content Production

App Store Today Tab

My Role: Editorial Producer
Team: Apple App Store Editorial

In my third contract with Apple, I worked with the App Store editorial team — the team responsible for writing and creating content for the Today tab, aka "the front page of the App Store."

My role was cross-functional, working regularly with Apple TV marketing to bring stories about new releases — like F1: The Movie, Pluribus, and Your Friends and Neighbors — to the Today tab and its 71 million visitors every day.

Coinbase - Experiential

Base Batches 003 Demo Day

My Role: Senior Producer
May 2026  ·  San Francisco
Concept: Base Creative Office  ·  Agency: Lauk and Key

Base Batches is a program for builders on Base (Coinbase's L2 blockchain) to kickstart their business. Think Shark Tank but less drama.

I produced the Demo Day event where 12 founders pitched their projects to investors and Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong. I managed our event vendor in addition to teams capturing social content on site, as well as coordinating last-minute keynote updates with our creative team.
